// ORPHANS C4 repro: seed a room, archive its messages (marker on the
// projection), import a DIVERGENT history that omits the archived ghost
// message, then read the archived views (search + thread) at three points:
//   (1) immediately after import, before any backfill;
//   (2) after the messages backfill completes;
//   (3) after the new history is itself archived.
// A ghost is "served" if the omitted message's body/id shows up in either
// reader at any point. Run from the lane worktree so imports resolve.
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { RoomStore } from "__R1ROOT__/server/store.mjs";
import { initialRoom } from "__R1ROOT__/server/bootstrap.mjs";
import { archiveMarker } from "__R1ROOT__/server/messages-store.mjs";
import { EVENT_TYPES as T, event } from "__R1ROOT__/src/events.js";

const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "orphans-c4-"));
const store = new RoomStore(join(dir, "room.sqlite"));
const roomId = "commons";
const at = offset => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 2) + offset * 1000).toISOString();
const msg = (id, messageId, body, offset, extra = {}) =>
  event({ type: T.MESSAGE_POSTED, actorId: "owner", roomId, id, idempotencyKey: `${id}-key`, at: at(offset), data: { messageId, body, ...extra } });

function finishBackfill() {
  let guard = 0, result;
  do {
    result = store.backfillMessages({ limit: 400 });
    if (result.budgetExceeded) throw new Error("backfill budget exceeded");
  } while (!result.done && ++guard < 200);
  if (!result.done) throw new Error("backfill did not finish");
}

function reads(label) {
  const owner = store.issueAccessKey(roomId, "owner");
  let searchHits = null, searchError = null;
  try {
    const found = store.search(owner, roomId, "ghostneedle");
    searchHits = found.messages.map(m => m.id);
  } catch (error) { searchError = error.code ?? error.message; }
  let threadRoot = null, threadError = null;
  try {
    const thread = store.messageThread(owner, roomId, "ghost");
    threadRoot = thread.thread?.id ?? null;
  } catch (error) { threadError = error.code ?? error.message; }
  const marker = archiveMarker(store.db, roomId);
  const ghostRows = store.db.prepare("SELECT count(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE room_id=? AND message_id IN ('ghost','ghost-reply')").get(roomId).n;
  console.log(`[${label}] marker.throughSeq=${marker.throughSeq} ghostRowsInTable=${ghostRows} searchHits=${JSON.stringify(searchHits)} searchError=${searchError} threadRoot=${threadRoot} threadError=${threadError}`);
  return { searchHits, threadRoot };
}

try {
  // --- Seed history A: 14 messages; the ghost sits early (seq well inside
  // the range an archive marker will cover), with one reply under it.
  const seed = [...initialRoom(roomId)];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) seed.push(msg(`ev-a${i}`, `a${i}`, `alpha ${i}`, 10 + i));
  seed.push(msg("ev-ghost", "ghost", "the ghostneedle body", 30));
  seed.push(msg("ev-ghost-reply", "ghost-reply", "reply under the ghost", 31, { replyToId: "ghost", alsoSendToChannel: true }));
  for (let i = 6; i <= 12; i++) seed.push(msg(`ev-a${i}`, `a${i}`, `alpha ${i}`, 40 + i));
  store.initialize(seed);
  finishBackfill();
  store.checkMessagesParity();

  // --- Archive history A down to the newest 4 messages.
  const archived = store.archiveMessages(roomId, { dryRun: false, keepNewest: 4 });
  console.log("archive A:", JSON.stringify(archived));
  const markerA = archiveMarker(store.db, roomId);
  const ghostSeq = store.db.prepare("SELECT seq FROM messages WHERE room_id=? AND message_id='ghost'").get(roomId)?.seq;
  console.log(`markerA.throughSeq=${markerA.throughSeq} ghostSeq=${ghostSeq} ghostInProjection=${store.room(roomId).state.messages.some(m => m.id === "ghost")}`);
  if (!(markerA.throughSeq >= ghostSeq)) throw new Error("seed failed: ghost is not under the archive marker");

  // Sanity: pre-import, the archived readers DO serve the ghost (proves the
  // readers can serve it from the table when a marker covers it).
  const before = reads("pre-import");
  if (!before.searchHits?.includes("ghost")) throw new Error("seed failed: pre-import search does not serve the ghost");

  // --- Divergent history B: A's events up to just before the ghost, then
  // fresh filler messages (different ids) pushing B's head past ghostSeq.
  // B omits the ghost, its reply, and A's later messages entirely.
  const allEvents = store.db.prepare("SELECT sequence, body FROM events WHERE room_id=? ORDER BY sequence").all(roomId)
    .map(row => ({ sequence: row.sequence, event: JSON.parse(row.body) }));
  const ghostEventSeq = allEvents.find(row => row.event.id === "ev-ghost").sequence;
  const kept = allEvents.filter(row => row.sequence < ghostEventSeq).map(row => row.event);
  const fillers = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) fillers.push(msg(`ev-b${i}`, `b${i}`, `bravo ${i}`, 100 + i));
  const linesB = [...kept, ...fillers].map((entry, index) => ({ sequence: index + 1, event: entry }));
  console.log(`history A events=${allEvents.length} ghostEventSeq=${ghostEventSeq} history B events=${linesB.length}`);

  const owner = store.issueAccessKey(roomId, "owner");
  const imported = store.importEvents(owner, roomId, linesB);
  console.log("import B:", JSON.stringify(imported));

  const step1 = reads("post-import, pre-backfill");

  finishBackfill();
  const step2 = reads("post-backfill");

  // --- Re-archive the NEW history (certify parity first, as the archive
  // door requires), then read again.
  store.checkMessagesParity();
  const archivedB = store.archiveMessages(roomId, { dryRun: false, keepNewest: 2 });
  console.log("archive B:", JSON.stringify(archivedB));
  const step3 = reads("post-re-archive");

  const served = [step1, step2, step3].some(s => s.searchHits?.includes("ghost") || s.threadRoot === "ghost");
  console.log(served ? "VERDICT: REPRODUCED — ghost served after divergent import" : "VERDICT: NOT REPRODUCED — ghost never served");
} finally {
  store.close();
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
}
